issue_context.title: Generic camera stops updating template stream_source/still_image_url
issue_context.body: ## The problem I have camera created on one HA instance and use this camera on another HA instance via generic camera integration. Of course, in order to use it you need specify actual token in stream_source and still_image_url, since official documentation says these parameters can be templates. It worked well for very long time but since 0.109.4(5?) template value of stream_source stops updating while sensor that contains token and is using in the template updates correctly. ## Environment - Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.109.4(5?) - Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): 0.109.3(?) - Operating environment (Home Assistant/Supervised/Docker/venv): Docker/Home Assistant Supervised (ex Hassio) - Integration causing this issue: Generic IP Camera - Link to integration documentation on our website: [https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/generic_ip_camera/](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/generic_ip_camera/) ## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml` The first HA instance (camera owner): ``` camera: - name: camera platform: rpi_camera file_path: /config/tmp/image.jpg sensor: - platform: template sensors: camera_token: # camera token in order to use this camera on another instance value_template: "{{ state_attr('camera.camera', 'access_token') }}" ``` The second instance: ``` sensor: - name: camera_token # token of camera from another instance platform: rest resource: !secret camera_token_url force_update: true verify_ssl: false headers: authorization: !secret another_instance_long_token value_template: "{{ value_json.state }}" camera: # another instance camera - name: camera platform: generic stream_source: http://192.xx.xx.xx:8123/api/camera_proxy/camera.camera?token={{ states('sensor.camera_token') }} still_image_url: http://192.xx.xx.xx:8123/api/camera_proxy/camera.camera?token={{ states('sensor.camera_token') }} ``` ## Traceback/Error logs Error message ``` Login attempt or request with invalid authentication from ``` ## Additional information Moreover, the HA rest api [documentation](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/external_api_rest/) intends to rest api call to camera from another instance but **tells nothing** about mandatory camera token parameter. It was better to add possibility to specify another instance camera token directly, for example, similar to ```Authorization: Bearer``` technique of the HA rest api access.
comments: Hi @balloob , could you please take a look on the integration?

review_comments: We need to set `hass` on the template before trying to render it. Please do that in the entity init method.
Check for `None` value before trying to render `self._stream_source`. If it's `None` just `return None`.
